screen.chromastudio.title: Chroma Studio
window.chromastudio.pin.no_world: A window can only be pinned in a world.
window.chromastudio.fullscreen.forced: The game window is too small for anything but fullscreen.
command.chromastudio.bad_hex: "%s" isn't a colour. Use six hex digits, like #ff8800.
command.chromastudio.debug.not_ready: The block index is still being built.
command.chromastudio.unknown_block: There's no block called "%s". Give a block's id, like oak_planks, or a colour, like #ff8800.
command.chromastudio.export.usage: Give a palette's share string, then a layout, a format and "place" if you like: /chroma export chroma1:stone,andesite wall nbt
command.chromastudio.export.unclosed: The share string starts with a double quote and has none to close it.
command.chromastudio.export.unknown_opti: "%s" isn't a layout, a format or "place". The layouts are strip, wall, patch_grid, noise_clusters, height_gradient and dither, and the formats litematic and nbt.
command.chromastudio.export.bad_share: That share string can't be read. %s
command.chromastudio.export.empty: Nothing was exported. This game has none of the palette's blocks.
command.chromastudio.export.skipped: Left out, as this game lacks them or the layout is full: %s
command.chromastudio.place.usage: Give the name of a file in the export folder: /chroma place chroma-stone-strip
command.chromastudio.place.done: Placed "%s" in Litematica at %s, %s, %s, selected to move.
export.chromastudio.litematica.missing: Litematica isn't installed, so the schematic wasn't placed. The file is saved.
export.chromastudio.litematica.no_world: A schematic can only be placed in a world.
export.chromastudio.litematica.unreadabl: Litematica couldn't read %s. The file is saved.
export.chromastudio.litematica.failed: Litematica couldn't place the schematic: %s. The file is saved.
settings.chromastudio.title: Chroma Studio settings
settings.chromastudio.reset.tip: Sets this group back to its defaults.
settings.chromastudio.undo.tip: Undoes this group's changes since you opened settings.
settings.chromastudio.undo.none: Nothing in this group has changed.
settings.chromastudio.reset_all.tip: Sets every setting to its default. Key binds stay.
settings.chromastudio.reset_all.confirm: Reset every setting to its default?
settings.chromastudio.undo_all.tip: Undoes every change since you opened settings.
settings.chromastudio.rememberWindow.tip: Reopens the window where you left it, at the same size and in the same mode.
settings.chromastudio.startTab.tip: The tab the window opens on the first time, before it remembers your last tab.
settings.chromastudio.pinOpacity.tip: How solid a pinned window looks, from 0.2 to 1.
settings.chromastudio.titleButtons.tip: Default puts the fullscreen button next to close. Flipped puts the pin button there.
settings.chromastudio.theme.tip: The colours of the window and this screen. Custom builds them from your own colour.
settings.chromastudio.customColour.tip: The colour that Custom builds the window's colours from.
settings.chromastudio.customColour.off: Set Window colour to Custom to use your own colour.
settings.chromastudio.colourFormat.tip: The colour space of the Match tab's sliders. Matching works the same in each.
settings.chromastudio.colour.rgb.tip: Red, green and blue, each 0 to 255.
settings.chromastudio.colour.hsv.tip: Hue 0 to 360, saturation and value 0 to 100.
settings.chromastudio.colour.hex.bad: Not a hex colour. Use six digits from 0–9 and A–F.
settings.chromastudio.colour.rgb.bad: Not an RGB colour. Use three numbers from 0 to 255.
settings.chromastudio.colour.hsv.bad: Not an HSV colour. Use a hue 0–360, then two numbers 0–100.
settings.chromastudio.colour.keys.tip: Arrow keys move the marker. Page Up and Down change the hue.
settings.chromastudio.defaultFace.tip: The block face Match compares when the window opens. Side is the best of four sides, Any the best of six.
settings.chromastudio.shading.tip: Compares faces as the game lights them, with sides darker than the top.
settings.chromastudio.metric.tip: How colour difference is measured. OKLab matches the eye and suits most uses.
settings.chromastudio.resultCount.tip: How many blocks a match lists, from 3 to 60.
settings.chromastudio.viewingDistance.ti: How far away you'll view the build, from 1 to 192. Further away, textures blur together.
settings.chromastudio.filterFullCube.tip: Starts Match with only full cubes listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterSolid.tip: Starts Match with only blocks you can't walk through listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterOpaque.tip: Starts Match with only blocks you can't see through listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterSurvival.tip: Starts Match without creative-only blocks, such as bedrock.
settings.chromastudio.showDeltaE.tip: Shows each result's colour difference as a number.
settings.chromastudio.technicalBlocks.ti: Also indexes blocks with no item in the creative inventory.
settings.chromastudio.statesSeparately.t: Lists each state of a block as its own row.
settings.chromastudio.statesCap.tip: The most states kept for one block, from 1 to 8.
Averages an animated texture's frames. Off, only the first frame counts.
settings.chromastudio.cacheFolder.tip: Where the block index is kept. Empty means config/chromastudio/cache.
settings.chromastudio.rebuildOnReload.ti: Rebuilds the block index whenever resource packs reload.
settings.chromastudio.refresh.tip: Rebuilds the block index from every texture. Use it after editing a loaded pack's files.
settings.chromastudio.biomeMode.tip: Where grass, leaves and water get their tint: where you stand, the chosen biome, or every biome as a range.
settings.chromastudio.biome.tip: The biome that Chosen uses, as an id like minecraft:plains.
settings.chromastudio.gradientSteps.tip: How many blocks a new gradient has, from 2 to 32.
settings.chromastudio.easing.tip: How a new gradient's colours are spaced between its stops.
settings.chromastudio.hueArc.tip: Which way round the colour wheel a new gradient's hue turns.
settings.chromastudio.spreadMatching.tip: Prefers blocks whose textures are as busy as their neighbours in the gradient.
settings.chromastudio.generateCount.tip: How many colours Generate makes, from 2 to 32.
settings.chromastudio.captureCount.tip: How many of the commonest blocks Capture keeps, from 1 to 64.
settings.chromastudio.hotbarOverflowMode: Shulker boxes in a hotbar fill
Where Hotbar puts blocks past the ninth. "Never" fills free slots and drops the rest, "When full" adds shulker boxes for what won't fit, and "Always" puts them all in shulker boxes.
settings.chromastudio.dioramaPerspective: How the 3D diorama is drawn. Perspective draws far blocks smaller, Orthographic keeps them as big as near ones.
settings.chromastudio.exportFolder.tip: Where exports are saved. Empty means Litematica's schematics folder, or the game's without Litematica.
settings.chromastudio.defaultLayout.tip: How an export arranges the palette's blocks.
settings.chromastudio.patchSize.tip: The side of each block's square in a patch grid, from 1 to 16.
settings.chromastudio.exportGap.tip: Leaves one block of air between entries in an export.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipMode.tip: When an item's tooltip shows its colour.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipSwatch.tip: Shows the block's colour as a swatch.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipHex.tip: Shows the block's colour as a hex code.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipKind.tip: Shows what kind of block it is, such as slab or stairs.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipBadge.tip: Shows whether the texture is flat, grainy or busy.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipDeltaE.tip: Shows how far the block's colour is from the Match colour.
settings.chromastudio.readoutSeconds.tip: How long the eyedropper's readout stays on screen, from 1 to 30.
settings.chromastudio.modKeys.tip: Opens the game's key binds at the mod's keys, including recipe lookup.
settings.chromastudio.litematicaPlacemen: Where an exported schematic is placed: at the block you look at, or where you stand.
give.chromastudio.no_world: This only works in a world.
give.chromastudio.no_permission: This needs creative mode or operator rights.
hotbar.chromastudio.nothing: None of these blocks has an item to hold.
hotbar.chromastudio.rest.slots: %s more went into free inventory slots.
hotbar.chromastudio.rest.box: %s more went into a shulker box.
hotbar.chromastudio.dropped: Blocks with no slot, dropped at your feet: %s.
hotbar.chromastudio.dropped_boxes: Shulker boxes with no slot, dropped at your feet: %s.
hotbar.chromastudio.left_out: Left out, as the game drops only so many at once: %s.
hotbar.chromastudio.nothing_to_undo: There's no hotbar fill to undo.
hotbar.chromastudio.undone: Put your hotbar back as it was.
hotbar.chromastudio.undone_dropped: Put your inventory back. Dropped items are still on the ground.
hotbar.chromastudio.no_permission: This needs creative mode or operator rights.
capture.chromastudio.keys: Press %s on a block. Escape cancels.
capture.chromastudio.too_big: That box is too big. A capture counts at most %s blocks.
capture.chromastudio.empty: That box holds only air, in the loaded chunks.
capture.chromastudio.name: Capture %s %s %s to %s %s %s
capture.chromastudio.done: Captured a palette of %s of the %s block types found.
command.chromastudio.capture.usage: Give two corners: /chroma capture x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2
palettes.chromastudio.new.title: New palette
palettes.chromastudio.rename.title: Rename palette
palettes.chromastudio.delete.title: Delete palette
palettes.chromastudio.delete.question: Delete "%s"? Its file is removed and this can't be undone.
palettes.chromastudio.import.title: Import a palette
palettes.chromastudio.import.hint: Paste a share string, or type a JSON file's path
palettes.chromastudio.import.empty: Paste a share string or give a file first.
palettes.chromastudio.unreadable.other_v: It's from another version of Chroma Studio.
palettes.chromastudio.unreadable.bad_pro: "%s" isn't a list of properties like axis=y.
palettes.chromastudio.unreadable.bad_wei: The weight in "%s" isn't a whole number from 1 up, or is too large.
palettes.chromastudio.unreadable.other_f: It's format %s, and only format %s can be read.
palettes.chromastudio.shared: Copied the share string. Tags and notes aren't in it.
palettes.chromastudio.copy.tip: Makes a copy of the palette that you can edit.
palettes.chromastudio.no_dialog: No file dialog came up. Type the file's path instead.
palettes.chromastudio.no_world: This only works in a world.
palettes.chromastudio.need_entries: This palette has no blocks yet.
palettes.chromastudio.preset_fixed: Presets can't be changed. Copy one to edit it.
palettes.chromastudio.index_building: The block index is still being built. Try again in a moment.
palettes.chromastudio.none_selected: Pick a palette on the left, or make one with New, Generate, Capture or Image.
palettes.chromastudio.empty: No blocks yet. Add them with + on a Match result, or use Generate, Capture or Image.
palettes.chromastudio.save_failed: The palette couldn't be saved. The log says why.
palettes.chromastudio.no_matches: No blocks matched under the default filters in the settings.
palettes.chromastudio.entry.unknown: %s isn't in this game. It's kept but left out of exports.
palettes.chromastudio.tool.capture.tip: Closes the window so you can press the eyedropper key on two corners, or Escape to cancel.
palettes.chromastudio.generate.title: Generate a palette
palettes.chromastudio.generate.in_hand.n: Hold a block to use its colour.
palettes.chromastudio.generate.roll.tip: Makes a palette from a random colour and harmony.
palettes.chromastudio.generate.bad_hex: That isn't a colour. Use six hex digits, like #ff8800.
palettes.chromastudio.generate.name: %s %s
palettes.chromastudio.image.title: Palette from an image
palettes.chromastudio.image.hint: Path to a PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP
palettes.chromastudio.image.unreadable: %s isn't an image that can be read.
palettes.chromastudio.analyse.heading: Findings: %s
palettes.chromastudio.analyse.none: Nothing to fix. This palette is balanced.
palettes.chromastudio.analyse.fix.tip: Opens Match on this colour to find blocks for it.
palettes.chromastudio.export.title: Export a schematic
palettes.chromastudio.export.gap.na: The diorama layouts fill every cell, so they have no gaps.
palettes.chromastudio.export.height.na: Only the wall and the diorama layouts have a height.
palettes.chromastudio.export.width.na: Only the diorama layouts have a width.
palettes.chromastudio.export.patch.na: Only the patch grid has a patch size.
palettes.chromastudio.export.place.tip: Places it in Litematica, selected to move.
palettes.chromastudio.export.place.nbt: Litematica places only .litematic files. Change Format to place it.
palettes.chromastudio.worldedit.title: WorldEdit command
palettes.chromastudio.worldedit.from.nee: Type the blocks to replace first.
palettes.chromastudio.worldedit.send.tip: Sends it as chat. Needs WorldEdit on the server and a selection.
clipboard.chromastudio.too_large: Too large to copy: %s KB, over the %s KB limit.
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.title: Fill the hotbar
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.fits: This fill fits in one hotbar.
gradient.chromastudio.stop.tip: Drag to reorder, right-click to remove
gradient.chromastudio.stop.two_needed: A gradient needs at least two stops.
gradient.chromastudio.stop.full: A gradient has at most %s stops.
gradient.chromastudio.easing.tip: How colours are spaced between stops: Linear, Smooth, Ease in or Ease out.
gradient.chromastudio.arc.tip: Which way round the colour wheel the hue turns: Shortest or Longest.
gradient.chromastudio.spread.tip: Prefers textures as busy as the gradient's ends.
gradient.chromastudio.too_few: Only %s blocks pass the filters, and the gradient needs %s. Loosen the filters or use fewer steps.
gradient.chromastudio.failed: The gradient couldn't be worked out. The log says why.
gradient.chromastudio.badge.tip: Average colour difference per step. %s or less is close, %s or less is fair.
gradient.chromastudio.swap.head: Step %s, wanted %s
gradient.chromastudio.swap.none: No other block passes the filters.
gradient.chromastudio.store.title: Saved gradients
gradient.chromastudio.store.failed: The saved gradients couldn't be written. The log says why.
gradient.chromastudio.store.delete.title: Delete gradient
gradient.chromastudio.store.delete.quest: Delete the saved gradient "%s"? This can't be undone.
gradient.chromastudio.store.replace.ques: A gradient called "%s" is already saved. Replace it with this one?
chromastudio.analysis.narrow_range: The blocks are all close in lightness, so the build may look flat. Add something lighter or darker.
chromastudio.analysis.narrow_range.title: Flat lightness
chromastudio.analysis.lightness_gap: There's a jump in lightness with nothing in between. A block in the middle would bridge it.
chromastudio.analysis.no_darks: Add a dark block for shadows and outlines.
chromastudio.analysis.no_darks.title: No dark blocks
chromastudio.analysis.no_highlights: Add a light block for highlights.
chromastudio.analysis.hues_stray: The hues don't sit on one colour harmony. A block of the missing hue would tie them together.
chromastudio.analysis.hues_stray.title: Hues out of harmony
chromastudio.analysis.no_accent: Every block is muted. One saturated block would stand out as an accent.
chromastudio.analysis.no_accent.title: No accent
chromastudio.analysis.too_saturated: Most of the blocks are strongly coloured. A muted block would balance them.
chromastudio.analysis.accent_contrast: The most colourful block is about as light as the rest, so it doesn't stand out.
chromastudio.analysis.too_busy: Most of the textures are busy. A flat or grainy block would calm the build.
chromastudio.analysis.too_busy.title: Too busy
chromastudio.analysis.texture_jump: The textures jump from flat to busy. A grainy block would sit between them.
chromastudio.analysis.texture_jump.title: Texture jump
chromastudio.analysis.too_small: With fewer than three blocks there's little to vary.
chromastudio.analysis.too_small.title: Too few blocks
chromastudio.analysis.too_large: More than twelve blocks can blur a build's look. Try splitting the palette.
chromastudio.analysis.too_large.title: Too many blocks
match.chromastudio.pick_block.tip: Closes the window. Look at a block and press %s.
match.chromastudio.pick_screen.tip: Hides the window until you click a colour or press Escape.
match.chromastudio.slot.tip: Click to match the block in your hand
match.chromastudio.distance.scale: A block face shows about %s texture pixels here. Each mark halves that.
match.chromastudio.biome.pick.off: Set Biome tint to Chosen first.
match.chromastudio.find_biome.no_block: Match a tinted block, such as grass or leaves, first.
match.chromastudio.find_biome.no_colour: Match a colour first, then the tinted block.
match.chromastudio.filter.more.tip: Lit while a filter in it is set.
match.chromastudio.filter.technical.tip: Blocks with no creative inventory item
match.chromastudio.filter.block_entity.t: Also chests, banners, shulker boxes and heads, whose colours are estimates.
match.chromastudio.filter.badge.tip: With none lit, all textures are listed.
match.chromastudio.row.add: Ctrl-click to add it to the palette
match.chromastudio.no_palette: Pick a palette on the Palettes tab first.
match.chromastudio.make_palette: Make a palette of these %s blocks
match.chromastudio.recipe.none: Install JEI, REI or EMI to look up recipes.
explore.chromastudio.clear_highlight.non: Analyse a palette on the Palettes tab to highlight its blocks.
eyedropper.chromastudio.no_block.how: Look at a block and press the key again.
eyedropper.chromastudio.not_ready: The block index is still being built
eyedropper.chromastudio.not_indexed.how: Blocks without a texture, such as air, have no colour.
picker.chromastudio.hint: Click a colour to pick it. Escape cancels.
give.chromastudio.disabled: %s is switched off in this world.
settings.chromastudio.hotbarAxiom: Axiom hotbars in a hotbar fill
settings.chromastudio.hotbarAxiom.tip: Puts blocks past the ninth in the Axiom hotbars after yours, in creative mode only.
axiom.chromastudio.missing.fabric_only: Needs Axiom, which runs on Fabric only.
axiom.chromastudio.failed: Axiom didn't say what its active block is.
axiom.chromastudio.taken.stone: Axiom: %s, or its editor is closed
axiom.chromastudio.block.unseen: Choose a block in Axiom's editor first.
axiom.chromastudio.editor.changed: This version of Axiom doesn't say whether its editor is open.
axiom.chromastudio.editor.not_back: Couldn't go back to Axiom's editor
axiom.chromastudio.editor.not_back.how: Press Axiom's editor key to open it again.
axiom.chromastudio.title: Axiom script
axiom.chromastudio.script.tip: Recolour swaps each block for a palette block of its shape. Scatter paints the palette's blocks at random.
axiom.chromastudio.script.over: Some servers refuse scripts over %s characters.
axiom.chromastudio.from.tip: Which blocks change: any but the ground, or only another palette's.
axiom.chromastudio.match.tip: Keep shading gives the build's darkest blocks the palette's darkest and its lightest the lightest. Closest colour picks the nearest colour.
axiom.chromastudio.axis.tip: The way the gradient runs, starting where you stand.
axiom.chromastudio.recolour.rules: Gives each block a palette block of the same shape, picked as Match says.
axiom.chromastudio.recolour.kept: Already in the palette, so kept: %s
axiom.chromastudio.recolour.unshaped: Left alone, as the palette has no block of their shape, or no see-through one for glass: %s
axiom.chromastudio.scatter.done: Scatters %s blocks at random, into air too.
axiom.chromastudio.scatter.done.one: Scatters one block, into air too.
axiom.chromastudio.scatter.rules: Paints the palette's blocks as often as their weights say, and leaves doors, tall plants and blocks that hold items alone.
axiom.chromastudio.scatter.none: None of the palette's blocks can be scattered, as Scatter places only whole blocks that stay put.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient.rules: Starts where you stand. The %s's own controls move its ends.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient.left_alone: Paints any solid block it reaches, but leaves air, the ground, plants, blocks that hold items, and stairs, slabs, walls, doors and blocks that face a way alone.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient.skipped: Left out steps aren't plain full blocks, or are missing from this game.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient.too_short: A gradient needs at least two blocks.
axiom.chromastudio.no_blocks: None of the palette's blocks are in this game.
axiom.chromastudio.nothing_to_change: Nothing would change: each block would stay as it is, or the palette has no block of its shape.
axiom.chromastudio.long: On those, use the Chroma gradient tool in Axiom's editor.
axiom.chromastudio.long.from: On those, pick a From palette captured from your build. It makes the script much shorter.
axiom.chromastudio.long.brush: On those, use the Chroma palette brush in Axiom's editor.
axiom.chromastudio.too_long: The script is %1$s KB, over the %2$s KB that copies safely. Use a palette with fewer blocks.
axiom.chromastudio.too_long.from: The script is %1$s KB, over the %2$s KB that copies safely. Pick a From palette, such as one captured from your build.
hotbar.chromastudio.filled.axiom: Filled your hotbar and %1$s. To reach them, open Axiom's menu with %2$s and scroll.
hotbar.chromastudio.undone_axiom: Put your hotbar and Axiom's hotbars back as they were.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.changed: This version of Axiom's hotbars isn't supported, so blocks past the ninth follow the shulker box setting.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.creative: Axiom's hotbars work only in creative mode.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.denied: This server doesn't allow Axiom's hotbars.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.failed: Axiom's hotbars didn't take the change, so nothing was changed. The log says why.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.instead: Axiom's hotbars take the blocks past the ninth instead.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.inactive: Axiom is off here, so its hotbars can't be used.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.failed_left: Axiom's hotbars stopped taking changes partway, so these slots are still changed: %s. Press Undo to put them back. The log says why.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.undo_left: Axiom's hotbars still aren't taking changes, so these slots weren't put back: %s. Press Undo to try again. The log says why.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.slot_empty: Axiom hotbar %1$s slot %2$s, which was empty
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.undo_first: Press Undo first to put back what the last fill left in Axiom's hotbars.
hotbar.chromastudio.axiom.moved: Nothing was filled, as where blocks past the ninth go just changed. Check the dialog and press Fill again.
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.replaces.on: Replaces what's in one slot of %s.
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.drops: %s may not fit. Any that don't drop at your feet, where Undo can't reach them.
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.drops.one: One may not fit. If it doesn't, it drops at your feet, where Undo can't reach it.
palettes.chromastudio.hotbar.axiom.tip: Puts blocks past the ninth in the Axiom hotbars after yours.
palettes.chromastudio.export.axiom: To use it in Axiom's editor: %1$s > %2$s.
axiom.chromastudio.incompatible.title: Chroma Studio's Axiom tools are off
axiom.chromastudio.incompatible.how: This Axiom version isn't supported. The log says why.
axiom.chromastudio.incompatible: This Axiom version isn't supported, so the Axiom features are off. A newer Chroma Studio may support it.
axiom.chromastudio.editor.unknown: Chroma Studio can't tell whether Axiom's editor is open
axiom.chromastudio.editor.unknown.how: If its window looks squeezed, close Axiom's editor before opening it.
axiom.chromastudio.editor.unknown.tools: This Axiom doesn't say whether its editor is open, so the tools change nothing.
axiom.chromastudio.not_ready: Still reading the blocks' colours. Wait a moment.
axiom.chromastudio.not_build: That isn't a build. Right-click a block of the build, not the ground or a plant.
axiom.chromastudio.radius.whole: Whole build takes every joined block, so it has no radius.
axiom.chromastudio.stopped: Chroma Studio's Axiom tools stopped after an error. Restart the game to use them again.
axiom.chromastudio.stopped.title: Chroma Studio's Axiom tools stopped
axiom.chromastudio.stopped.how: Restart the game to use them again.
axiom.chromastudio.apply.tip: Changes the blocks. One undo takes it back.
axiom.chromastudio.masked: %s blocks are kept out by the tool masks.
axiom.chromastudio.masked.one: One block is kept out by the tool masks.
axiom.chromastudio.capped: The build is bigger than %s blocks, so only the part nearest where you started is included.
axiom.chromastudio.masks.tip: The tool changes only blocks the mask under %s allows, and only inside the selection if there is one.
axiom.chromastudio.masks.off.tip: Axiom applies tool masks only while its %s window is open, docked or minimised.
axiom.chromastudio.preview.busy: Another tool's preview is showing. Finish or cancel it, then try again.
axiom.chromastudio.refused.index: Chroma Studio read the blocks' colours again.
If you didn't change it, give the getSimplexNoise or getVoronoiEdgeNoise in the mask's script a seed.
axiom.chromastudio.open.tip: Opens Chroma Studio. The editor comes back when you close it.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.scatter.tip: Paints the palette's blocks at random, by weight, and skips doors and blocks that hold items.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.scatter_none: Scatter can't place any of this palette's blocks. Choose another palette.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.recolour.tip: Gives each block the palette's block of its shade and shape. Blocks the palette already has stay as they are.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.empty: None of this palette's blocks are in this game. Choose another palette.
axiom.chromastudio.mask.unknown: This Axiom's tool masks can't be read, so the tools change nothing.
axiom.chromastudio.mask.failed: The tool masks stopped answering. Restart the game to use the tools.
axiom.chromastudio.mask.lua: The mask's script has an error. Fix it, or close the error under %s.
axiom.chromastudio.mask.lua_invalid: The mask's script doesn't compile. Fix it, or use the Mask tab.
axiom.chromastudio.mask.lua_invalid.tip: Axiom's Scripting tab marks the error.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.left_out.tip: Scatter places full blocks, so stairs and slabs go in as their full block and blocks that can't stand alone are left out.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.whole.tip: Right-click a build to preview all of it recoloured, then press Apply.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.from.tip: Which blocks change. This build takes its shading from the build you right-click. A palette changes only its own blocks.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.pick: Right-click a build to preview it.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.kept: %s stay, as the palette has them.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.kept.one: One stays, as the palette has it.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.from_gone: The From palette was renamed or deleted. Choose From again.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.no_entries: This palette is empty. Add blocks to it in Chroma Studio.
axiom.chromastudio.brush.materials.tip: The build's blocks, darkest to lightest, which set the shading.
axiom.chromastudio.eyedropper.how: Right-click a block to match its colour.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.open_ta: Opens Chroma Studio's Gradient tab, whose gradient then shows here.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.missing: This gradient has fewer than two full blocks that this game has.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.skipped: %s of its blocks are left out, as they aren't full blocks or this game lacks them.
One of its blocks is left out, as it isn't a full block or this game lacks it.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.blend.t: How far neighbouring steps fade into each other. 0%% gives hard bands.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.like_fi: Changes only the start's material and its shapes, so the ground and other materials stay.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.like.ti: The start isn't a full block. Untick Only blocks like the first to include the rest of the build.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.reach.t: Blocks from the line between the ends, 1 to 64
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.length: %s blocks end to end, about %s a step.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.left_al: %s blocks stay, such as doors, panes and blocks that hold items.
One block stays as it is: a door, a pane or a block that holds items.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.capped: Lower the reach, or turn on Only blocks like the first.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.straigh: The ends are nearly in line, so the gradient runs straight.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.steps_l: Only full blocks this game has can be steps.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.diagona: The gradient runs on the slant between the ends.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.adjust: Right-click another block to move the nearer end.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.need: Make a gradient on the Gradient tab first.
axiom.chromastudio.gradient_tool.unusabl: This gradient needs two full blocks. Choose another.
Stairs, slabs and blocks this game lacks can't be steps.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.darker.tip: Each block becomes its next shade darker, such as stone bricks to tuff bricks.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.lighter.tip: Each block becomes its next shade lighter, such as stone bricks to polished andesite.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.step.tip: 1 to 5: how far a stroke moves each block's shade
axiom.chromastudio.shade.strength.tip: 10 to 100%%: the share of blocks a stroke changes, so strokes blend
axiom.chromastudio.shade.from.tip: The blocks the brush may use: plain building blocks, or only a palette's.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.no_shades: None of this palette's blocks can be a shade.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.no_shades.tip: A shade is a solid full block, or its stairs or slab, that doesn't fall.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.point: Point at a block to see its next shade.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.becomes.scripte: Becomes %s if the mask's script allows it
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.never: Stays: the brush shades only solid blocks and their shapes.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.turns: Stays: blocks that face a way keep their look.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.ground: Stays: the brush leaves the ground alone.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.kind: Stays: this shape is off under Block shapes.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.darker: Stays: no shade a step darker is close enough.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.lighter: Stays: no shade a step lighter is close enough.
axiom.chromastudio.shade.left.masked: Stays: the tool masks keep it out.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.build.tip: Takes every block joined to the one you right-click.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.ground.tip: Also counts plants and the ground, such as grass, dirt and bedrock.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.ground.build: Whole build never spreads into the ground. Use the brush to add some.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.new_world: You're in another world, so the sample started over.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.name: Name
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.save.tip: Adds the sample to your palettes, each block weighted by its count.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.save.done: Already saved. Sample more blocks to save again.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.save.failed: Couldn't save the palette. The log says why.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.saved.renamed: You already have a palette called %s.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.open.tip: Shows the palette on Chroma Studio's Palettes tab, saving it first if needed.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.clear.tip: Empties the sample. Palettes saved from it stay.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.how.brush: Sweep over a build to sample its blocks.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.how.build: Right-click a build to sample all of it.
axiom.chromastudio.sampler.how.tip: Stairs, slabs and walls count as their material. Air, liquids and blocks that hold items never count.
